reviews.outcome: VDB-PT15-01 records the missing support/unused-parameter hypothesis in Lemma2.4. The corpus retains nonempty supported universes with infinite unused complement and proves its own prime deductively closed theory variant, finite-support witness construction, native substitution truth lemma and strong completeness in explicit countable syntax scope. The source existential assignment display on p.7 reverses the usual assignment notation; actual substitution uses the defined newest-slot convention. Classical Hintikka machinery and Hilbert comparisons are not newly adopted.
